A nitrogen-containing heterocyclic compound N-(3-(5-Mercapto-1H-tetrazol-1-yl) phenyl) acetamide (named
L) was investigated as a new leveler to develop the microvias Cu <sup>fi</sup>lling with or without cracked plating in blind

carry out super<sup>fi</sup>lling of microvias.

4.1. Electrochemical details
The electrochemical measurements were carried out with an elec
trochemical workstation CHI 760E(Auto-Lab) equipped a standard
three-electrode cell containing 250 mL electrolyte. A platinum rotating

ing electrode (WE). The counter electrode (CE) was a copper bar
placed in a hollow glass pipe <sup>fi</sup>lled with base electrolyte. Moreover,
the reference electrode (RE) used the mercurous sulfate electrode
(SMSE). All the potential values involved in this work are referred to
SMSE scale. The galvanostatic measurements (GM) were used to inves-
tigate the adsorption of additives and evaluate the <sup>fi</sup>lling ability of the
plating solution. Before GM tests, a layer of copper with the thickness
of about 500 nm was pre-plated on the platinum rotating disk elec-
trode for 5 min to transform Pt-RDE into Cu-RDE. During the galvano-
static measurements, the spinning speeds of the WE were taken at 100
and 1000 rpm to simulate the bottom and surface of the microvias,
respectively. The electrolyte was controlled at a constant temperature
of 298 K and the current density was
2 . 0 \ \mathrm { A } / \mathrm { d } \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 }
. The inhibiting effect

range is from 0.3 V to − 0.8 V. Chronoamperometry (CA) tests were
conducted by the glassy carbon working electrode for a 3 mm diame-
ter. All the experiments mentioned above must be carried out three
times under the same conditions to ensure good repeatability.
